bullets.text: Roblox Launches 4D Creation Feature - **Roblox**'s new 4D creation tool enhances interactivity for digital items, now in open beta.
Tim Cook Highlights Visual Intelligence - **Apple**'s visual intelligence feature is gaining traction and may soon become even more powerful.
iOS 26 Passwords App Update - **Apple**'s iOS 26 introduces a feature to recover unsaved generated passwords, easing user frustrations.
AirPods Live Translation Expands - **Apple**'s iOS 26.2 update brings Live Translation to more **AirPods** users across the EU.
Motorola's Budget Phones Lack Updates - **Motorola**'s latest budget phones ship with outdated Android 15 and no promised OS upgrades.
Sam Altman Critiques Anthropic Ads - **OpenAI**'s Sam Altman calls **Anthropic**'s Super Bowl ads 'dishonest' amid competitive tensions.
Valve's Steam Machine Delayed - **Valve** delays the launch of its Steam Machine due to ongoing memory and storage shortages.
Snap Reports Revenue Growth - **Snap** sees a 10% revenue increase in Q4 but faces a decline in daily active users.
Mundi Ventures Raises €750M - **Mundi Ventures** closes its largest fund to support deep tech and climate startups in Europe.
Duna Secures €30M Series A - **Duna**, a startup for business identity verification, raises €30 million backed by **Stripe** alumni.
